The '''Turak system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Parmel sector/Legends|Parmel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Turak IV]].<ref name="TBoT" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' mistakenly places the Turak system in R-4.<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
